reuse.why: Re-implements the null/number/range dispatch inline instead of calling the existing exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which decides exactly this and is used by forecast, schedules app, budget templates and the UI.

duplication.why: The nested ternary duplicates getScheduledAmount's whole decision, including its furthest-from-zero comparison copied verbatim.

placement.why: Computing the field in scheduleModel.toExternal is a reasonable place for an API projection, but the business rule itself belongs in (and already lives in) shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the new field; the Omit<..., 'expectedAmount'> adjustments to create/update input types are necessary consequences.

maintainability.why: A second definition of the expected-amount rule will drift from getScheduledAmount when the rule changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal expectedAmount ternary, instead of getScheduledAmount(schedule._amount) from shared/schedules.ts

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts toExternal: getScheduledAmount's if-chain reshaped into a nested ternary expression
